card.name: Inside drug names in interaction passages
card.fires_on: Partway through a drug name (such as verapamil, ibuprofen, Zestril, captopril) in drug-interaction text, often just before 'and' or 'with' a second drug. Also fires on a few linking words in the same setting.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a drug name when the text is describing how two drugs interact.
